decision_dimensions.question: Does the architecture support confirmed website and workflow requirements?
Can it reliably connect with the customer's existing systems?
Can the required security and access controls be implemented and validated?
Can non-technical users manage approved content effectively?
Can the architecture meet agreed performance requirements?
Can the customer or delivery team maintain and evolve the solution?
What existing capabilities or data could be affected?
What are the implementation and ongoing operating costs?

rules: Do not assume one framework is always optimal.
Do not invent vendor capabilities or prices.
Compare meaningful alternatives when the choice is consequential.
Require validation before committing to unsupported integrations.
Prefer simpler architectures when they satisfy the confirmed requirements.
